title: Chokepoints Calculus: Uneven Fees, Risks & Consequences
section_path: Chokepoints Calculus: Uneven Fees, Risks & Consequences

summary:
Main
Image reference: assets/2026-08-05_chokepoints-calculus-uneven-fees-risks-amp-consequences_img_rgb-color-brs-shipbrokers-monogram-l_c365f35f1de5.png
Recent developments in the Black Sea, the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea are a stark reminder that maritime trade does not evolve in a linear or predictable fashion. Routes that appear to be normalising can quickly face renewed security risks, forcing commercial assumptions to be revised. Against this backdrop, a year-to-date review of the major maritime chokepoints offers a useful snapshot of the operating landscape for dry bulk participants.
